game.title: DUSKHEARTH
game.subtitle: Keep the ember. Outlast the night.
ui.worlds.empty: No worlds yet. Create your first one with “New world”.
ui.error.webgl2.title: WebGL2 is not available
ui.error.webgl2.body: DUSKHEARTH draws its light, shadows and pixel art with WebGL2. Your browser is not providing WebGL2 right now, so the game cannot start.
ui.error.webgl2.hint: How to fix it: update your browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari) to the latest version, enable hardware acceleration in the browser settings and restart the browser. If that does not help, update your graphics driver.

loading.title: Loading …
loading.world.failed: The world could not be created: {error}
loading.tip.1: Fear grows in the dark. Light, fire and cosy rooms bring it back down.
loading.tip.2: While the Hearthfire burns, no Shadowspawn appears within its radius. Keep it fuelled.
loading.tip.3: Block just before a hit lands to parry: the enemy staggers and your next hit is critical.
loading.tip.4: Small items close to you are picked up automatically.
loading.tip.5: Food spoils over time. Cooling chests and ice cellars keep it fresh much longer.
loading.tip.6: Carrying light makes enemies spot you from twice as far. Sometimes darkness is the better cover.
loading.tip.7: Eating the same dish three times a day halves its nourishment. Variety pays off.
loading.tip.8: The game saves automatically at regular intervals, when you sleep and when you leave.
settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: Reset all settings to their defaults?
settings.saveFailed: Settings could not be saved: the browser is blocking local storage. Allow site data for this page or leave private mode.
settings.repaired: Some saved settings were invalid and have been reset to their defaults.
settings.graphics.quality.desc: Sets point lights, shadows, water and particles together. Individual options can be adjusted afterwards.
settings.graphics.autoDetected.desc: The quality level was chosen by a short benchmark on first start.
settings.graphics.lightBanding.desc: Quantises light into a few brightness bands – the classic 16-bit look.
settings.graphics.lightBands.desc: More bands give smoother gradients, fewer a bolder retro look.
settings.graphics.dither.desc: Blends light bands and transitions with a fine pixel pattern.
settings.graphics.scaleMode.desc: “Sharp” fills the screen without distorting pixels, “Pixel-perfect” scales by whole numbers only, with borders.
settings.graphics.fpsLimit.desc: Caps frames per second to save power or keep fans quieter.
settings.graphics.vsync.desc: Synchronises frames with the display to prevent tearing.
settings.graphics.crt.desc: Simulates the scanlines and curvature of a CRT television.
settings.graphics.bloom.desc: Bright lights and embers glow softly into their surroundings.
settings.graphics.fog.desc: Draws layers of fog through forests, marshes and caves.
settings.graphics.godRays.desc: Sunbeams shine through the canopy when the sun is low.
settings.graphics.weatherParticles.desc: Amount of rain, snow, ash and sand.
settings.graphics.shadows.desc: Quality of shadows cast by lights and the sun.
settings.graphics.gi.desc: Glowing surfaces and lights tint their surroundings. Only active at quality level Ultra.
settings.graphics.water.desc: Rendering of waves, shore foam and reflections.
settings.graphics.maxLights.desc: How many light sources are computed at the same time.
settings.graphics.particleLights.desc: Sparks and magical particles cast their own light.
settings.graphics.adaptiveLightBuffer.de: Briefly lowers the lighting resolution when performance drops so the game stays smooth.
settings.audio.sfx.desc: Volume of footsteps, combat, crafting and building.
settings.audio.ambience.desc: Volume of wind, weather, animals and water.
settings.audio.visualSoundCues.desc: Arrows at the screen edge point to threats you would otherwise only hear.
settings.controls.bindings.desc: Rebind every action for keyboard, mouse and controller.
settings.controls.mouseSensitivity.desc: Speed when panning the map and camera with the mouse.
settings.controls.stickSensitivity.desc: Cursor speed with the right stick.
settings.controls.stickDeadzone.desc: How far a stick must move before it reacts. Raise it if your character drifts on its own.
settings.controls.sprintMode.desc: Hold the button, or press once to toggle.
settings.controls.sneakMode.desc: Hold the button, or press once to toggle.
settings.controls.blockMode.desc: Hold the button, or press once to toggle.
settings.controls.vibration.desc: Controllers rumble on hits and events.
settings.controls.aimAssist.desc: Gently steers stick aiming towards nearby enemies.
settings.game.hudMode.desc: “Contextual” shows displays only when needed, “Minimal” shows only the essentials.
settings.game.compassBar.desc: Shows a compass bar at the top with the cardinal points, the start beach and your grave.
settings.game.damageNumbers.desc: Shows damage dealt and taken as numbers.
settings.game.funkeComments.desc: Funke, the flame spirit, gives short hints of at most two lines.
settings.game.autosaveMinutes.desc: How often the game saves automatically.
settings.game.developerMode.desc: Unlocks the performance overlay (F3), the console (^) and other developer tools.
settings.accessibility.colorblind.desc: Adjusts colours. Important states also have their own symbols.
settings.accessibility.screenshake.desc: Strength of shaking on hits and explosions.
settings.accessibility.flashReduction.de: Dims lightning, hit flashes and flickering lights.
settings.accessibility.reducedMotion.des: Less camera motion, shaking and menu animation.
settings.accessibility.gameSpeed.desc: Slows down all gameplay for more reaction time.
settings.accessibility.uiScale.desc: Size of menus and HUD in whole pixel steps.
input.rebind.prompt: Press a key or button for “{action}” …
debug.overlay.title: Performance
debug.console.title: Developer console
debug.console.placeholder: Type a command – “help” lists all commands
debug.console.help.help: Lists all commands or shows help for one command.
debug.console.error.disabled: The developer console is only available with ?debug=1 or in developer mode.
debug.cmd.set.help: Changes a setting, e.g. “set language en” or “set graphics.quality ultra”.
debug.cmd.speed.help: Sets the simulation speed as a factor, e.g. “speed 4” to fast-forward, “speed 0.5” for slow motion, “speed 1” for real time.
debug.cmd.freeze.help: Freezes game time (“freeze on”) or lets it run again (“freeze off”).
debug.cmd.world.notReady: The world is still being created – try again in a moment.
debug.cmd.tp.help: Puts the figure on tile (x, y) of a layer (0, -1, -2, -3), creating it there if there is none; without coordinates to the start beach. Example: “tp 450 1400 -1”.
debug.cmd.time.help: Shows day, time, season and moon; “time 18:30” jumps to the next 18:30, “time +90” 90 game minutes ahead.
debug.cmd.season.help: Shows the season; “season winter” jumps to 06:00 on the first day of the next winter.
debug.cmd.season.set: Time jumps to the start of: {season}.
debug.cmd.weather.help: Shows the weather of the region under the camera; “weather regen” sets it there, “weather regen alle” everywhere.
debug.cmd.weather.noRegion: There is no weather here (open sea or cave).
debug.cmd.seed.help: Shows seed and size of the world; “seed 4242” reloads the page with a new world from that seed.
debug.cmd.seed.reload: Loading a new world from seed {seed} …
debug.cmd.overlay.help: Switches an overlay of the game view on or off: chunks, collision, temperature field. Without a name: all states.
debug.cmd.player.none: No player in the world – in debug mode it appears with ?spieler=1.
debug.cmd.give.help: Puts items into the player's bags, e.g. "give feuerstein 3".
debug.cmd.kill.help: Puts the player's light out at once (death with the death screen).
debug.cmd.god.help: God mode: the player takes no damage (falls, hunger, thirst, cold, heat, drowning, conditions, hallucinations). "god an", "god aus", no argument: toggle. "kill" still works.
debug.cmd.noclip.help: Noclip: the player walks through walls, cliffs, trees and deep water without swimming. "noclip an", "noclip aus", no argument: toggle.
debug.cmd.unlock.help: Unlocks (basic form): every skill – or one, e.g. "unlock bergbau" – at its highest level; its perk choices open.
debug.cmd.unlock.done: Every skill at level {level} – the perk choices are open.
debug.cmd.unlock.doneOne: {skill} at level {level} – the perk choices are open.
debug.cmd.inspect.help: Entity inspector: "inspect an" – a click on the game view shows the components of the entity under it (Alt + click always works); "inspect aus" ends it.
debug.inspector.label: Entity inspector
debug.inspector.title: Entity {entity} · index {index} · gen. {generation}
